selected_next_work: Implement paired original/incremental fixed-circuit evaluation and a complete bounded-error/erasure decoder, then prepare one fresh controlled 48-curve study. No new trial is launched under BATCH-07e7ab.

primary.why_factorial: Separate erasure reconstruction from defined-bit correction; t0.e0 exactly embeds the actual original strictinterval procedure.
primary.exposure: Circuit and working-domain results from EXP8dc19d were exposed before this design; confirmation excludes all exposed(p,j) keys.
primary.decoder_policy: All L queries; enumerate complete bounded Hamming/erasure word set; fixed deterministic order; strict half-open interval and both public equations; no pruning/fallback/all-r search.
primary.verification_policy: Primary future version uses direct independent scalar checks; Gray/floorcarry is a separate optional future implementation after equivalence tests.
primary.reference_implementation: Run actual original ungated_attempt as the matchedreference. New listt0.e0 mustmatchqueries/status/scalar/interval; any extra decodercontrolwork ispricedseparately, notassertedcounter-identical.

stages.nonce_stream: independent of every other stage; exact future freeze required
independent of A and all calibration data; no intervening tuning

source_specific_refinements.list_stopping: Proposed observational implementation enumerates all allowed words in fixed order, including after a recovery, and retains first-success index; every word/empty interval and public check is charged. Final protocol must lock this or an explicitly distinct stopping law.
source_specific_refinements.candidate_budget_reference: For each decoder cell, M is the number of distinct legal canonical scalar candidates (including zero if the candidate permits it), not the number of words or the two verification equations. Uniform reference samples without replacement from the same frozen canonical domain; define saturation at r and cap/undefined cases.
source_specific_refinements.t0_baseline: Actual compute.ungated_attempt is the paired original reference. List t0.e0 must preserve every original semantic outcome; extra list bookkeeping is separately charged rather than asserted counter-identical.
source_specific_refinements.calibration_evaluator_scope: All eight frozen arms are characterized with the original evaluator. The selected paired original/incremental primary comparison is circuit2.a1 on the confirmation query bank. The earlier separate 24-curve eight-arm engineering proposal is not silently added to this workload.
source_specific_refinements.factorial_pairing: All six t∈{0,1,2}×e_max∈{0,2} cells reuse one incremental predicate trace. They are paired decoder outcomes, not six independent query samples. Standalone algorithm costs still charge that algorithm its complete query work.

planned_counts_excluding_additional_cont.scope: Derived from the proposal only, not executed counts. Additional controls, A/A/reset/isomorphism/mutation probes, independent verification, setup and references require exact separate count rows before freeze. No extra incremental calibration panel is included.

isolation_plan.target_generation: Retain uniform unlabelled public-coordinate sampling. The public sampling nonce reconstructs public points, not secret scalar labels; it is not itself a known-k leak. If any future variant instead forms Q=[k]P with known k, its generation seed and labels must be private and inaccessible to the candidate.
isolation_plan.old_route_boundary: The existing cohort sampler is unlabelled, but the old compute program subsequently performs fresh BSGS/diagnostics in its VM. Do not describe the historical whole VM as scalar-label-free.
isolation_plan.new_worker: Candidate-only, public inputs, no fresh BSGS/log tables/truth diagnostics, source/import closure pinned. Retain established B2 CPU VM/UID1000/network block/no secrets if source flow probes pass.
isolation_plan.post_seal_host: Collect/seal the complete worker outputs and verify full readback, then establish worker quiescence/termination acknowledgement before the trusted host constructs scalar logs, runs independent math diagnostics and BSGS/reference work. No label/reference output is fed back to a live candidate.
isolation_plan.qualification: Host baselines and candidate VM may use different backends. Counter-law comparisons disclose that boundary; there is no matched timing claim. Source inspection/planned separation are not proof the future isolation probes passed.

controls: Matched original/incremental full semantic traces; A/A; reset/reordered target probes.
Perfect and deliberately broken truth-aided abstract channels confined to host validation; correlated-error examples do not enter a candidate API.
Public wrong-root, constant-all-residues, punctured-constant and identity-delta calibration controls where relevant.
Exact-mask/odd/anchor synthetic reference with specified finite support and paired chart transport; no automatic p-value.
Candidate-budget-matched uniform scalar lists and working host BSGS with backend/memory limits disclosed.

inference.primary_contrast: Registered t1.e2 versus t0.e0 under fixed circuit2.a1; erasure-only/flip-only cells are prespecified secondary factor isolation.
inference.experimental_units: Curve is the population unit; targets/restarts, six decoder cells, null functions and isomorphic charts are nested or paired. Confirmation A/B are independently seeded and never tuned between panels.
inference.correlation_precision: The 1800 draws per calibration curve/arm support the producer fixed-curve simultaneous ±0.1 Hoeffding design under the specified independent-draw model across K=192 cells. They do not certify transfer to a fresh curve.
inference.event_scale: 512 independent fresh blindings per confirmation curve use q=0.02 only as a planning scale, not a prediction. Zero-event bounds/intervals retain true-rate uncertainty.
inference.population_limit: Twenty-four heterogeneous confirmation curves do not inherit a tight population-of-curves precision guarantee. The controls lane illustrative128-curve design and its broad bound remain separate; there is no exponent fit.
inference.null_reference: Constrained random functions are descriptive model references unless the frozen null makes the candidate exchangeable with them; a plus-one rank does not create that assumption.

required_families: all successful and failed scalar/public checks
cost_law.restart: S_curve+T_target+E[C_online]/q under its stated independent restart law. Batch work per success event and unique-target coverage are distinct descriptive quantities.
cost_law.zeros: At zero observed hits, empirical work/qhat is undefined; true q=0 is not inferred.
cost_law.qualification: No counter advantage before independent execution replay; clocks unqualified absent separate isolation/calibration evidence.

admission_blockers.required: Implement source-bound complete t/erasure list enumeration, strict interval, both public equations, deterministic word order and every cap/status, with no hidden pruning or fallback.
admission_blockers.check: Independent enumerator count/uniqueness/completeness tests and negative mutations of bits, upper inequality, a/b conversion, erasures and truncation; exact t0.e0 embedding.

admission_blockers.required: Bind paired original and incremental evaluators to identical public query schedules, full traces and reset semantics.
admission_blockers.check: Independent arithmetic/branch reference plus independent counter execution replay; 11 producer fixture tests alone do not qualify execution counters.

admission_blockers.required: Implement the selected single-primary-arm synthetic odd/anchor/exact-mask reference, support counting, ties/replacement/duplicate accounting and fixed chart coupling.
admission_blockers.check: Reject nonsymmetric masks/undefined anchors; retain degenerate support; label reference contrasts descriptive unless an exchangeability null is proved.

admission_blockers.required: Use public coordinate sampling and a candidate-only isolated worker with no scalar labels, fresh BSGS or truth/orbit diagnostics.
admission_blockers.check: Inspect exact source/import closure, candidate input schema, filesystem/descriptor/network/process probes and seed namespaces. Host labels/baselines run only after seal, full readback and quiescence/termination acknowledgement.

admission_blockers.required: Freeze exact sampler population, exclusions, all outcome and query counts, evaluator/cell execution semantics, controls/reference counts, memory/setup/cache boundaries and analysis before any fresh data.
admission_blockers.check: A new experiment.protocol/v1 and complete source/input/runtime/admission chain must pass; this design is not that protocol or an approval.

admission_blockers.required: Keep two independently seeded confirmation panels untouched by discovery/validation and disclose prior F23-informed choices.
admission_blockers.check: No interim seed/arm/radius/scale/cap fitting; curve-level heterogeneity and fixed-domain restart uncertainty reported separately.

admission_blockers.required: Keep Fourier routes separate from this radius trial until an executable learner/reduction and numerical/query error budget are supplied.
admission_blockers.check: AGS Theorem5 excerpt defers general construction; Boolean tau^-5.5 is weight dependence, not an unsourced ternary amplitude^-2 bound; charge O(tau^-2) cross-list candidates and both learner failure probabilities.

secondary_unimplemented_leads.radius_verification_reuse: Gray/revolving-door/floor-carry candidate point updates require independent completeness/equivalence and paid initialization before replacing direct checks.
secondary_unimplemented_leads.multiplication_code: AGS bounded-complex/segment route needs executable construction or checked reduction, actual query costs and erased-answer encoding.
secondary_unimplemented_leads.two_SFT: Keep same prepared P, anchor/mask/identity rule; find nonzero heavy coefficients, enumerate/price both frequency lists and O(tau^-2) cross candidates, numerical thresholds and two failure budgets. No heavy component or learner cost is measured here.
secondary_unimplemented_leads.cocycle_query_reuse: Public addition-chain state reuse may reduce oracle arithmetic but all initialization/cache/query work remains charged; it supplies no extra scalar information.

outcome_rules.measurement_success: Complete planned outputs, passing controls and independent equations/coverage, retained all cost/failure/undefined/cap rows. An improvement is not required to report observations.
outcome_rules.implementation_failure: Equation/trace/control/coverage/source/isolation/count mismatches are implementation or integrity discrepancies to isolate, not broad mathematical refutation.
outcome_rules.informative_scoped_outcome: Measured recovery/error/cost distributions relative to the registered working reference, with uncertainty and both panels disclosed.
outcome_rules.inconclusive: Wide intervals, sparse events, heterogeneity, learner/numeric ambiguity or qualification gaps remain explicit, with a concrete next check.
